the development of a novel class of anti-cancer agents, the PAT-SM6 IgM antibodies.
the interaction of the anti-cancer monoclonal antibody PAT-SM-6 with its target GRP78.
the development of a new type of antibody-based anti-cancer agent and its mechanism of action.

the PAT-SM6 antibody is a high avidity binder of the GRP78 protein.

the binding constant of a multimeric antibody with a multimeric antigen may be significantly different than the binding constant of the antibody with a monomeric version of the antigen.
